spOrderers.title: Orderer access
spOrderers.subtitle: Separate permission: only the access set here counts — not managed stores in Staff, not store manager role. Applies to all supplier seasonal preorders; a store not enabled on a form still cannot order.

table.colCanViewHint: This year's orders + last year's data
table.permissionMissing: Missing the "Supplier seasonal preorder ordering" permission, so the menu is hidden. Grant it in Roles.
table.removeConfirmContent: This person will no longer be able to order for: {{stores}}. Existing quantities are not affected.

modal.typeToSearch: Type a name or account to search
modal.switchedToEdit: This person is already listed; switched to editing their current access
modal.canView: Can view other stores' orders and last year's data
modal.canViewHint: When off, the ordering page hides "Other stores ordered" and "Store comparison"
modal.footHint: Takes effect immediately; open ordering pages update after refresh
modal.storeRequired: Select at least one store; use "Remove" to revoke all access

spOrderers.rule1: Can order for a store = granted that store here AND the form has that store enabled. Both are required; otherwise the page is read-only and explains why.
spOrderers.rule2: This page is independent of Staff: store changes or transfers don't update it; buyers and area managers without a primary store can be granted too.
spOrderers.rule3: "Can view other stores" is also set per person here: when off, the ordering page hides "Other stores ordered" and "Store comparison".
spOrderers.rule4: Only people with SupplierPreorder.Manage can open this page and change access; every change is logged (who, when, which stores added or removed).
